jordan (sales): Quick sync — Manticore PM reached out. They want to run a POC using a new model 'manticore-17b-v2' and prefer an int8/q4a quantized variant. Also asked for KMS integration and a dedicated VPC for the POC. Any immediate compatibility blockers?

Tess (solutions): Thanks Jordan. Couple of quick checks: sequence lengths they expect, kv-cache persistence needs, and whether they require streaming. Do we have this data from the SO?

jordan (sales): They said typical prompts ~1k tokens, some long contexts up to 6k but rare. Streaming preferred for chat, and they want deterministic rollback if we fall back to a smaller variant.

Puneet (eng-ml): FYI int8/q4a quantization usually works but depends on the model's training artifacts (e.g., grouped linear layers). Need to run a quick kernel compatibility check. Also, for 6k contexts we should confirm our KV cache sharding config — large sequences + quantization can hit memory limits on smaller GPUs.

Puneet (eng-ml): I'll run a compatibility probe today. If it fails, fallback plan: provide a 13B fp16 or q4 variant with prefix-preserving caching.

Tess (solutions): Sounds good. Would it be OK to propose: POC on Hosted first (fast), then Dedicated if they need the VPC/KMS isolation? That keeps time-to-demo short.

maria (security): KMS + VPC adds compliance overhead. We need to confirm encryption-at-rest for KV cache snapshots, HSM/KMS key rotation policy, and audit trail retention. For a Dedicated POC we can enable customer-managed keys (CMK) but that adds ~2–3 days to setup for networking and IAM.

manticore-pmo (customer): @jordan confirmation — we prefer dedicated from day 1 because of PHI. Can you confirm it won't delay onboarding more than a week?

alex (sales_manager): We can prioritize a quick Dedicated sandbox but realistic estimate is 5–7 business days for VPC peering + KMS binding and firewall rules. If they accept an interim hosted demo (no customer KMS), we can cut to 1–2 days.

jordan (sales): I'll ask if they're OK with a hosted demo first. Meanwhile, @puneet can you post the compatibility probe results and any preflight requirements we should send to the customer?

Puneet (eng-ml): Will do. Quick note on token accounting: quantized variants can change per-token cost; recommend we run an eval on their sample workload to estimate unit costs. Also watch out for generation tail latency with 6k contexts — batching strategy matters.

Tess (solutions): Preparing a short preflight checklist for the customer. Draft items: example payloads, expected qps, max sequence lengths, required response determinism, KMS key arn if Dedicated, allowed egress CIDRs. Will share in a few hours.

maria (security): Add: required SOC2 controls, and whether they'd need dedicated audit log shipping (we can forward to customer Splunk/Datadog). Also need their SOC contacts for the questionnaire.

deploy-bot: infra-check: available-instance-pools for dedicated: 4xA100-40GB (sustained), 2xH100 (spot), region-us-west-2. No immediate capacity conflicts.

Puneet (eng-ml): Ran a quick local probe (summary): model architecture has grouped FCLayers; q4a likely OK, but int8 needs per-tensor calibration. Two issues: 1) kv cache snapshotting disabled by default for quantized runtimes (can enable with memory tradeoff), 2) a small attention kernel fallback required for seq>4096 on some kernels. I'll open a short runbook snippet: 

```
model: manticore-17b-v2
variant: q4a
notes: requires per-tensor calibration; enable_kv_snapshot: true (watch memory)
seq_limit_recommendation: 4096 for optimal latency; >4096 requires tuned attention kernel
```

Tess (solutions): Great — that's exactly what I need for the preflight. Can we also capture an expected cost delta for q4a vs fp16 for a 1k-token average workload?

Puneet (eng-ml): Rough estimate: q4a reduces model memory and inference cost ~35–45% vs fp16 on same hardware; but for heavy seq workloads the batching inefficiencies could eat into that. I'll run a small benchmark on the 1k sample and post numbers.

alex (sales_manager): Pricing note: For POCs we typically offer 2 weeks of discounted hours + engineering support. Dedicated sandbox pricing: one-time setup fee + daily reserved capacity. I'll draft a numbers sheet once Puneet posts the perf delta.

maria (security): One blocker to call out for legal: if they want Bring-Your-Own-Key (BYOK) and cross-account KMS, legal will need to review the SLA addendum. Timeline + contact?

jordan (sales): I'll loop in legal once customer confirms BYOK. @manticore-pmo please confirm BYOK requirement and whether they can do temporary hosted demo without KMS for the first 48–72 hours.

manticore-pmo (customer): We can do hosted demo for the first 48h but need BYOK for the longer POC. Also will upload sample prompts this afternoon.

Tess (solutions): Perfect. Next steps I have: 1) finish preflight checklist, 2) Puneet to run perf/cost probe, 3) Alex to propose POC pricing, 4) Maria to list security docs we need. Will post an internal summary + customer-facing checklist by EOD. :+1:

jordan (sales): Thanks team — this thread is perfect. I'll update the customer once we have the checklist.

Puneet (eng-ml): Posting numbers tomorrow AM.

maria (security): Sending list of required compliance docs in ~3 hours.

alex (sales_manager): I'll prepare a tentative POC quote and mark it as draft.

deploy-bot: ticket-created: infra/poce-3163141592 for dedicated sandbox provisioning (owner: eng-platform).
